7251.title: Provider notices escape the running turn during timeline projection
7251.rootCauseOneLine: Thread-scoped notices remain standalone while the planner expands the entire earlier-starting turn first.
7251.proposedFix: Associate warning and deprecation operation messages with the turn running at their sequence using the existing grouping path.
7251.caveats: Offline shared-projection reproduction only; no fresh live desktop/provider/theme verification.
